doc.brief: Values for [`TextBufferCommitNotify`](xref:gtk:Gtk.TextBufferCommitNotify) to denote the point of the notification.
doc.md:
Values for [`TextBufferCommitNotify`](xref:gtk:Gtk.TextBufferCommitNotify) to denote the
point of the notification.

after_delete.brief: Be notified after text has been deleted from the underlying buffer.
after_delete.md:
Be notified after text
  has been deleted from the underlying buffer.

after_insert.brief: Be notified after text has been inserted into the underlying buffer.
after_insert.md:
Be notified after text
  has been inserted into the underlying buffer.

before_delete.brief: Be notified before text is deleted from the underlying buffer.
before_delete.md:
Be notified before text
  is deleted from the underlying buffer.

before_insert.brief: Be notified before text is inserted into the underlying buffer.
before_insert.md:
Be notified before text
  is inserted into the underlying buffer.
